user.title: Add a school service
user.description: Add SchoolHub once per login: once for the SWOP school portal and once for each child's Drei Köche lunch account. Children are matched by name.

swop.title: SWOP school portal
swop.description: Log in with the same account you use on the SWOP website. A parent or family account shows all its children.

data_description.url: Pick your school or enter the address of its SWOP portal, e.g. `https://my-school.swop.schule`. Just `my-school` works too.
data_description.username: Your SWOP login name, as on the website.

drei_koeche.title: Drei Köche
drei_koeche.description: Log in with one child's Drei Köche account. Add SchoolHub again for each further child.

data_description.username: The child's Drei Köche login name.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer accepted. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: The current password for this login.

error.invalid_auth: The username or password is wrong.
error.cannot_connect: The service could not be reached. Check the school address and try again.
error.no_students: The login works, but no children were found for it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.
error.invalid_url: This is not a valid address. Enter e.g. `https://my-school.swop.schule`.
error.https_required: The address must start with `https://` so the password is sent encrypted.

abort.already_configured: This login is already set up.

init.title: Date range
init.description: Which weeks to fetch, counted from the current week.

data_description.weeks_past: Past weeks to fetch, e.g. for recent homework.
data_description.weeks_future: Coming weeks to fetch, e.g. for the timetable and lunch.

unknown_homework.message: This homework no longer exists in SWOP.

homework_read_only.message: Homework comes from SWOP and can only be ticked off, not edited.

auth_failed.message: {service} rejected the login. Log in again.

student_not_found.title: No SWOP child found for {name}
student_not_found.description:
The Drei Köche login "{entry}" belongs to **{name}**, but no child with this name was found in SWOP. SWOP knows: {swop_names}.

Check the spelling of the names at both services. Until they match, the lunch of {name} can't be shown together with a timetable.

student_similar_name.title: {name} matched to {swop_name} despite different spelling
student_similar_name.description:
The names at Drei Köche (**{name}**) and SWOP (**{swop_name}**) differ slightly ({similarity} similar). SchoolHub assumes it is the same child.

If that is wrong, fix the name at one of the services. You can ignore this message if the match is right.

entity_prefix_mismatch.title: Lunch and timetable of {name} have different entity IDs

confirm.title: Combine lunch and timetable of {swop_name}

abort.entity_id_taken: One of the new entity IDs is already in use. Rename the entities manually under Settings → Entities.
